subject: Helio.ai late-stage capacity confirmation & 30d provisional hold (DL-2029-1178)

From: Tim Cho <tim.cho@helio.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@helio.ai>
Date: 2029-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity request: late-stage commitment for Helio.ai (DL-2029-1178)

Naomi —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Helio is preparing to commit to Redwood Dedicated for our customer-facing inference workload (multi-tenant product). We expect an initial production footprint of roughly 6x A100-80GB-equivalent instances (sustained), with burstable capacity to 8 units for onboarding. Average throughput estimate: ~100k tokens/day; peak concurrent queries expected at ~120 qps across two model shards. Target go-live: 2029-06-15.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood confirm immediate availability in us-west-2 and whether we can put a provisional hold until contract signature? Prefer a 30-day provisional hold with an option to extend by mutual agreement.
2) If full A100s are constrained, share recommended fallback (quantized variants / mixed instance plan) and any expected latency degradation.

We need high 99th-percentile guarantees for latency (target ~180ms) and an estimated monthly committed cost so we can finalize procurement.

Attaching our traffic profile and initial SLOs. Please loop in whoever owns Dedicated capacity.

—Tim
Tim Cho
Head of Platform
Helio.ai

Attachment: helio-traffic-profile-20290503.csv (referenced)

Team — forwarding Helio.ai ask (see below). Key constraints: go-live 2029-06-15, requested 6x A100-80GB sustained, burst to 8. They want a 30-day provisional hold until contract is signed.

Please run a fleet availability check for us-west-2 (and us-east if necessary), with the following deliverables by EOD Monday:
- Exact available free units by GPU SKU (A100-80GB, H100-80GB, and quantized node counts)
- Estimated lead time for provisioning remaining units if we need to spin capacity (days)
- Cost delta for mixing in quantized nodes / q8_0 variants vs full precision nodes
- Recommendation on whether to offer a 30-day provisional hold and any blocking caveats (maintenance windows, rolling upgrades)

If we can’t guarantee six full A100s, propose a blended plan that meets the 99p latency target close to 180ms or explicitly call out expected delta. Put proposed hold on paper (I’ll use our provisional-hold-form if ops agrees).

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Manager, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Naomi / team — quick scan from ops: attached a short capacity snapshot for us-west-2. Highlights:
- Current free A100-80GB capacity in us-west-2: 4 units immediately available.
- Additional 2 units can be reclaimed from planned maintenance pool in ~18-21 days (pending window confirmation).
- We have 6 additional H100-compatible nodes that can be provisioned as 4-bit quantized endpoints (q8_0 style) with ~12–18% throughput improvement per GPU for token throughput, but latency profile varies by model and prompt length.

Recommendation: offer a 30-day provisional hold for 6 logical units using a blended plan: 4x native A100-80GB + 2x quantized-capable H100 nodes configured for q8_0 inference. Set a routing policy: prefer A100 for production-critical queries, spill to quantized nodes for background batch/onboarding traffic. This keeps peak 99p latency within ~10–15% of target per our microbenchmarks.

Caveats:
- The two reclaimed A100s are contingent on a planned maintenance slip window (we can push but not indefinitely).
- Quantized nodes need a brief validation run with Helio’s model artifacts to confirm latency under their prompt distribution.

I attached: capacity-snapshot-usw2-20290504.pdf and a provisional-hold-form template. If you want the hold active, I can flag the units in the provisioning queue and generate a hold ticket.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Infrastructure Capacity Planner
Redwood Inference

Naomi — I ran a quick cost/latency estimate with the runtime team. A few concrete numbers to help the sales conversation with Helio: 
- Baseline (6x A100-80GB): estimated committed spend ~$68k/mo. 99p latency (single-shard) projected ~150–180ms depending on prompt mix.
- Blended (4 A100 + 2 q8_0 H100 nodes): estimated committed spend ~$52k/mo; expected 99p latency ~170–200ms for their reported mixes — within a ~10% tolerance but depends on model input lengths.

Operational ask: if we do the provisional hold, propose a clause that allows us to reassign the two reclaimed A100s if a higher-priority enterprise migration triggers (then provide 7 days notice). That protects ops while still offering Helio certainty.

Action items for sales thread:
1) Naomi / Ben: present the blended pricing option and the 30-day provisional hold language to Helio.
2) Marissa: please lock the provisional-hold ticket and mark the A100s as "hold-pending-contract".
3) Infra: schedule a brief 1–2 hour validation window with Helio to run the model on quantized nodes (we'll need a short dataset and <= 2 hours of runtime).

—Rishi

Director, Resource Orchestration
Redwood Inference
